$:set -euo pipefail
cd "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE"
for p in terminal/AGENTS.md terminal/README.md terminal/tasks/AGENTS.md terminal/tasks/README.md terminal/tasks/fishFry/AGENTS.md terminal/tasks/fishFry/README.md;do if test -f "$p";then echo "NEW_DOCUMENT $p";cat "$p";exit 2;fi;done
SRC='terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_minus01_centered_1448x1448_rotated_cw0p5_clean_upper_right_724x724.png'
DST='terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_minus01_centered_1448x1448_rotated_cw0p5_clean_upper_right_724x724_arrow_removed_opencv_base.png'
EDGES='terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_upper_right_724x724_arrow_removed_sobel_x.png'
test -f "$SRC" && test ! -e "$DST" && test ! -e "$EDGES"
test "$(sha256sum "$SRC" | cut -d' ' -f1)" = '4e6728722184fa091512afdf733ce2e72e822cc17369aeda49a936d923f22c74'
python3 -m venv /tmp/fishfry-arrow-remove-opencv-venv
/tmp/fishfry-arrow-remove-opencv-venv/bin/python -m pip -q install opencv-python-headless Pillow
/tmp/fishfry-arrow-remove-opencv-venv/bin/python - <<'PY'
from pathlib import Path
import cv2,numpy as np,hashlib,base64,io
from PIL import Image
src=Path('terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_minus01_centered_1448x1448_rotated_cw0p5_clean_upper_right_724x724.png')
dst=Path('terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_minus01_centered_1448x1448_rotated_cw0p5_clean_upper_right_724x724_arrow_removed_opencv_base.png')
edges=Path('terminal/tasks/fishFry/pizza_screen_upper_right_724x724_arrow_removed_sobel_x.png')
a=cv2.imread(str(src),cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)
assert a is not None and a.shape==(724,724,3)
roi=np.zeros((724,724),np.uint8)
roi[430:,640:]=(np.max(a[430:,640:],axis=2)<100).astype(np.uint8)
n,lab,stats,_=cv2.connectedComponentsWithStats(roi,8)
candidates=[(int(stats[i,cv2.CC_STAT_AREA]),i) for i in range(1,n) if stats[i,cv2.CC_STAT_AREA]>1000]
assert len(candidates)==1,candidates
area,index=candidates[0]
x,y,w,h=map(int,stats[index,:4])
assert (x,y,w,h)==(668,475,44,249),(x,y,w,h)
mask=(lab==index).astype(np.uint8)*255
mask=cv2.dilate(mask,cv2.getStructuringElement(cv2.MORPH_ELLIPSE,(5,5)),iterations=1)
modified=cv2.inpaint(a,mask,3,cv2.INPAINT_TELEA)
assert modified.shape==a.shape
outside=mask==0
assert np.array_equal(a[outside],modified[outside]),'altered pixels outside arrow mask'
masked_pixels=np.count_nonzero(mask)
changed_pixels=np.count_nonzero(np.any(a!=modified,axis=2))
assert masked_pixels>area and changed_pixels>area//2,(masked_pixels,changed_pixels)
dark_before=int(np.count_nonzero(np.max(a[430:,640:],axis=2)<100))
dark_after=int(np.count_nonzero(np.max(modified[430:,640:],axis=2)<100))
assert dark_before>=area and dark_after==0,('dark arrow remains',dark_before,dark_after)
assert cv2.imwrite(str(dst),modified)
loaded=cv2.imread(str(dst),cv2.IMREAD_COLOR)
assert loaded is not None and loaded.shape==(724,724,3)
assert np.array_equal(loaded,modified)
grayscale=cv2.cvtColor(loaded,cv2.COLOR_BGR2GRAY)
blur=cv2.GaussianBlur(grayscale,(3,3),0)
grad_x=cv2.Sobel(blur,cv2.CV_32F,1,0,ksize=3)
sobel=cv2.convertScaleAbs(grad_x)
assert cv2.imwrite(str(edges),sobel)
reopened=cv2.imread(str(edges),cv2.IMREAD_GRAYSCALE)
assert reopened is not None and reopened.shape==(724,724)
assert np.array_equal(reopened,sobel)
source_sha=hashlib.sha256(src.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
clean_sha=hashlib.sha256(dst.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
edge_sha=hashlib.sha256(edges.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
assert source_sha=='4e6728722184fa091512afdf733ce2e72e822cc17369aeda49a936d923f22c74'
print('OPENCV',cv2.__version__)
print('ARROW_BOUNDING_BOX',x,y,w,h,'ORIGINAL_MASK_AREA',area,'DILATED_MASK_PIXELS',masked_pixels,'CHANGED_PIXELS',changed_pixels)
print('DARK_PIXELS_IN_ROI_BEFORE',dark_before,'AFTER',dark_after)
print('VERIFICATION','all pixels outside narrowly dilated arrow mask unchanged; arrow absent; PNG readback identical')
print('CLEAN_BASE',dst,'DIMENSIONS',(724,724),'BYTES',dst.stat().st_size,'SHA256',clean_sha)
print('SOBEL_X',edges,'DIMENSIONS',(724,724),'BYTES',edges.stat().st_size,'SHA256',edge_sha)
preview=Image.fromarray(cv2.cvtColor(modified,cv2.COLOR_BGR2RGB)).resize((440,440),Image.Resampling.LANCZOS)
buf=io.BytesIO(); preview.save(buf,'JPEG',quality=50,optimize=True)
p64=base64.b64encode(buf.getvalue()).decode()
assert len(p64)<90000
print('PREVIEW_BASE64:'+p64)
PY
git add -- "$DST" "$EDGES"
test "$(git diff --cached --name-only | wc -l)" -eq 2
git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' commit -m 'Remove annotation arrow and establish clean OpenCV mesh analysis base'
gh auth setup-git
for attempt in 1 2 3 4 5 6 7 8;do
 printf 'PUSH_ATTEMPT %s\n' "$attempt"
 git fetch --quiet origin main
 git -c user.name='github-actions[bot]' -c user.email='41898282+github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com' rebase origin/main
 if git push origin HEAD:main;then
  printf 'COMMITTED ';git rev-parse HEAD
  printf 'REMOTE_HEAD ';gh api repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/git/ref/heads/main --jq .object.sha
  for f in "$DST" "$EDGES";do
    LOCAL_SHA=$(git hash-object "$f")
    REMOTE_SHA=$(gh api "repos/BestNameYet/Terminals/contents/$f" --jq .sha)
    test "$LOCAL_SHA" = "$REMOTE_SHA"
    printf 'VERIFIED_REMOTE %s %s\n' "$f" "$REMOTE_SHA"
  done
  exit 0
 fi
done
echo PUBLICATION_FAILED >&2
exit 1
